name: evm-dev
description: Tells whether an ERC is final or an EIP is live on Ethereum mainnet, and what it lets contracts and wallets do, from dated items checked against the official documents, re-checking the ones that are out of date

interface.longDescription: Answers whether an ERC is final or an EIP is live on Ethereum mainnet, which network upgrade brought it, and what it lets contracts, wallets, and dApps do, such as new opcodes, precompiles, gas costs, and EIP-7702. Each answer comes from an item checked against the official ERC or EIP document, with the date it was checked and its source. Items past the days their status allows are re-checked against the official document before the agent answers, and when the document cannot be reached the agent says so instead of answering from memory. It covers ERCs and the EIPs that change what contracts and wallets can do, not the state of L2 networks. It uses Bash and never changes its items.
defaultPrompt: Is EIP-7702 live on Ethereum mainnet?
